newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche Bank up after profit report.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Bank up after profit report.

text.p: Shares in Deutsche Bank climbed on Thursday after the company said its net profits in the nine months to September 30 had climbed nine percent to 1.53 billion marks.
The net profits were below analyst forecasts, which had averaged 1.7 billion marks, but analysts said the results were not too much of a disappointment.
Deutsche Bank shares were up 18 pfennigs, or 0.25 percent, at 71.75 marks in a generally weaker market.
The DAX index of 30 shares was down 0.62 percent, or 16.73 points, at 2,682.73.
Deutsche Bank said it expected its positive earnings trend would continue for the rest of 1996.
